name: Fields of Grief
summary: Apothecary Johaan tests his pumpkin weapon in Brill. He has laced pumpkins from Solliden Farmstead with his latest alchemical concoction and sends you to feed one to a captive Scarlet Crusader.

sections.title: A Weapon of Ingenuity
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan believes the Forsaken must use every advantage against the Scourge to the north and human incursions to the south. The Royal Apothecary Society looks beyond blades and dark sorcery, seeking weapons in the ordinary produce of the land. Johaan has tainted pumpkins gathered from the mortal farmers at Solliden Farmstead. He means to prove common crops can be made deadly in service of the Dark Lady.

sections.title: The Cellar Test
sections.body: Beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, a captive Scarlet Zealot waits in chains. Starvation has weakened the prisoner, but the zealot still defies the Forsaken and calls on the Holy Light to purge the undead. When offered a pumpkin, the captive mistakes it for food and devours it. Johaan's formula quickly warps the zealot into a rotting ghoul, who collapses lifeless in the dirt.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan use a pumpkin for his poison?
faq.answer: Johaan wants to prove ordinary crops can become weapons against the living. The Royal Apothecary Society laces produce from nearby human farms with alchemical mixtures, turning mortal foes' need for food against them.

faq.q: Who is the prisoner in the tavern cellar?
faq.answer: The prisoner is a Captured Scarlet Zealot, a Scarlet Crusade fanatic taken by Forsaken forces in Tirisfal Glades. Starvation and isolation have weakened the zealot, but religious fervor remains until food appears.

faq.q: What happens to the Scarlet Zealot after eating the pumpkin?
faq.answer: Johaan's formula takes hold almost at once, deforming the starving zealot into a rotting ghoul who collapses lifeless in the dirt.

faq.q: Where is the Gallows' End Tavern cellar?
faq.answer: The cellar lies beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. A ramp behind the front counter leads to the holding area where Forsaken guards keep prisoners.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to achieve here?
faq.answer: Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Royal Apothecary Society develops biological and alchemical agents to destroy the Scourge and mortal threats such as the Scarlet Crusade. Its small experiments on captives in Brill test these concoctions.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade active in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade sees all undead as abominations to be exterminated, whether mindless Scourge or free-willed Forsaken. Its camps and garrisons across the former kingdom of Lordaeron seek to reclaim the land by holy fire.

angles.text: For you as Forsaken, this experiment shows the ruthless measures your people take to survive, with mortal zealots to the south and the Lich King's armies to the north.
For you in the Horde, the Royal Apothecary Society's biochemical research can unsettle the Forsaken's new allies, yet it remains central to securing Tirisfal Glades for the Horde.
